BiblicalUsage: Hakupha is named twice, among the children of the Nethinim who returned from exile with Zerubbabel. Ezra and Nehemiah both count his children in the returning families.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God counts the servants as carefully as the priests: Hakupha's family is on the return list by name.
